relevant_data:
3 compartments: Biota (Biota, Aquatic); Aquatic (Marine/Salt Water); Aquatic (Aquatic Sediment)

18 biota samples. Species (3): Strongylocentrotus droebachiensis, Fucus vesiculosus, Mytilus edulis. Tissue types (4): Total soft tissues minus gonads, Gonad, Shoot tips, Total soft tissues. Life stages: Adult. Genders: Not reported

7 protocols:
Sampling Protocol - Grab sampling: (Green sea urchins collected at depths between 1 and 10 m using nets either attached to a pole or dragged across the sea floor from a boat, put into polyethylene bags and frozen)
Sampling Protocol - Point sampling: (Blue mussels (c. 10 individual per site) and seaweed collected from shore at low tide. For seaweed, the fresh growth tips were cut from the rest of the plants using stainless steel scissors)
Sampling Protocol - Grab sampling: (Sea bottom sediment collected using an Ekman grab sampler and the upper c. 5-cm layer sampled from three different spots and pooled into one bag)
Sampling Protocol - DGT: (Measurements of labile dissolved metal concentration in seawater using DGT sampling devices (Diffusive Gradients in Thin films) suspended in the water column c. 3 m above the bottom and deployed from 2 to 11 August 2017)
Fractionation Protocol - Acid extractable: (All samples were either fractionated with acid or acid + microwave)
Extraction Protocol - Microwave-assisted acid digestion: (Freeze-dried subsamples of biota (c. 300 mg) microwave-digested (Anton Paar Multiwave 3000) in Teflon bombs in 4 ml/4 ml Merck Suprapure HNO3/MilliQ water)
Extraction Protocol - Acid digestion: (Freeze-dried subsamples of sediment (c. 200 mg) digested in a mixture of 0.25 ml/0.75 ml/3 ml Suprapure HNO3/HCl/HF in Berghof bombs at 120 °C for 4 h, then diluted with MilliQ water and the HF was neutralised by boric acid)
limitations: Many matrices/mediums were sampled, but not all potentially relevant details were provided for each of these.
